channel.title: Mullvad Causing Panel Crash
channel.description: Recently a bug has appeared when I am using mullvad browser. It causes my panel to crash/disappear and I get a popup saying panel has crashed too many times, auto restart has been disabled until next login.

item.title: Mullvad Causing Panel Crash
item.dc:creator: arraybolt3
item.description:
I don’t think that’s the same bug. That bug was caused by inappropriate fontconfig cache symlinks being created by Chromium, and I don’t see any symlinks in ~/.cache/fontconfig on my end after running Mullvad Browser.

I tried to reproduce again by browsing with Mullvad for a little over five minutes and still didn’t manage to make it happen. It’s possible the issue only occurs when graphics acceleration is enabled. Could you try forcing software rendering by following the instructions here:

Kicksecure – 19 Sep 26

Software Rendering (Pixman) - NVIDIA

This chapter forces software rendering (Pixman) and disables Nouveau acceleration. This can improve stability on some NVIDIA systems at the cost of performance. Software rendering is not a separate driver. It simply disables hardware acceleration. It...

(Note that these instructions are in with the NVIDIA documentation since that’s when they are usually needed, but they can mostly be used even if you aren’t using NVIDIA graphics. You can omit the Nouveau-related steps if you aren’t using NVIDIA hardware.)

This is most likely a Mullvad Browser bug, so I would suggest discussing on their forums if they have forums. I probably won’t spend much more time debugging this since it doesn’t appear to be a Kicksecure bug.
